S1.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
S1.answer:
**Get Clássica:** Rental is free at R$10,000/month in sales, otherwise R$79.90/month. It has a 3G chip, Wi-Fi and a receipt printer, and accepts contactless and Pix via QR Code. It is aimed at faster payments and receipts. (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/, https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/termos_e_condicoes_aluguel.pdf)

**Get Smart:** Rental is free at R$60,000/month in sales, otherwise R$129.90/month. It has a 3G chip with a free data plan and Wi-Fi, and accepts contactless and Pix via QR Code. It focuses on complete management, integrating the order with payment, and you can receive per installment or in 1 business day. (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/, https://site.getnet.com.br/get-tap-03-11-25/)

S4.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
S4.answer:
Yes. To sell with Pix on Get Tap, you must enable the feature and link a bank account in the Getnet Brasil app. The linked account is the one that receives the Pix payments.

Steps: log in to the app, go to "Serviços" > "Venda com Pix" > "Habilitar", then choose your bank and follow the on-screen instructions to link the account.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix-no-get-tap-mais-agilidade-e-eficiencia-das-vendas/

S5.answer:
Your terminal GS-77A1 has been offline since 2026-11-14 at 07:04 (UTC-3). It is set to Wi-Fi, and the weak signal is the most likely cause. Its firmware is also one version behind (4.2.1 installed, 4.3.0 available).

- **Get Smart:** tap "Configurar", then "Conexões", then Wi-Fi. Pick your network and run "Teste de Connection". [Manual](https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Manul-GetSmart.pdf)
- **Get Clássica:** tap WI-FI or Suporte, choose "Habilitar Wi-Fi", then "Procurar Redes". Select your network and enter the password if asked. [Manual](https://sitehml.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Manul_GetClassica.pdf)

If it still won't connect, I can open a ticket for our human team to look into it.

S6.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
S6.answer:
Receivables advance lets you receive credit card sales (lump-sum or installments) before the original scheduled date, in exchange for a fee. It is not a loan: you get money that is already yours, with no new debt. (https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/)
In the Getnet Brasil app, you can check available receivables, simulate the advance and see the net amount before confirming. The fee may affect your profit margin. (same URL)
On the Get Smart terminal: Home > "Pagamento" > "Antecipação" > enter the merchant password > select the card brand > "Antecipar" > enter the advance code from the earlier query. A receipt is then printed. (https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Manul-GetSmart.pdf)

S9.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
S9.answer:
With Crediário Getnet you can split a sale into up to 48 installments. The exact maximum depends on the customer's issuing bank: the folder notes that some banks allow up to 24x, while Santander allows up to 48x, and this is subject to change. The customer also needs enough available credit card limit to cover the full purchase amount.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Folder_Credirio.pdf

S10.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
S10.answer:
Yes. Getnet's Payment Link lets you generate a customized link and send it via WhatsApp, social networks, email, or any other digital channel. The customer pays by credit card, debit, or Pix, with no card machine needed.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento-getnet/ and https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento-vendas/
